review_candidates.title: Flight Control & Dynamics Engineer
review_candidates.description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About The Role Harmattan AI is pushing the boundaries of high-speed autonomous flight, where control has to hold up at the edge of the envelope. Getting that right across a family of airframes is one of the most demanding parts of the flight software. As a Flight Control & Dynamics Engineer, working out of Lausanne, Paris, or Zurich, you will own control law design and the system identification that feeds it, setting the control standard as the team grows. You will weigh classical against learning-based methods, from tuned control laws to reinforcement-learning policies trained in simulation and flown on hardware, and decide what actually flies. Responsibilities System Identification: Design excitation maneuvers and fit airframe models from flight data, with quantified error bounds. Control Law Design & Tuning: Inner rate and attitude loops through outer position loops, with allocation, gain scheduling, and manual or automated tuning across the airframe family and flight envelope. Sim-to-Real: Keep the in-house simulator faithful to the identified model, so control developed in simulation transfers to the aircraft. Model Consumption: Turn the stability derivatives and coefficient tables from Aerodynamics into flying control. Flight Test & Diagnosis: Verify across simulation, SITL, and HITL, including Monte Carlo campaigns, then fly and iterate from logs. Mentorship: Depending on seniority, support the team by mentoring junior control and GNC engineers. Candidate Requirements Educational Background: A strong academic record with a degree in aerospace, controls, robotics, or a related STEM field. A practical track record matters more than the specific degree. System Identification & Control: Proven, hands-on identification and control on multirotor or fixed-wing platforms, validated in flight, with depth in at least one of MPC, INDI, or geometric control. Embedded Realization: Real-time control implementation on constrained targets, split cleanly between a microcontroller and a companion computer. Learning-Based Control: Familiarity with reinforcement learning and simulation-based training, and the judgment to know when a learned policy beats a classical design. Professional Attributes: Empirical and hardware-honest, disciplined about experiments and validation, grounded in real flight data. Communicates clearly, able to present control and test results to engineers and senior stakeholders. Thrives under pressure in a fast-paced environment with a no-task-is-too-small mentality. Bonus: Multi-airframe or hover-to-cruise transition experience. Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission of providing a defensive edge to allied nations through ethical, high-impact technology. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

review_candidates.description: Position: Engineering Operations Director 근무지: 서울 본 포지션은 글로벌 기업의 한국 Engineering Operations를 총괄하는 시니어 리더십 포지션으로, 전국 사업장의 엔지니어링 운영 표준, 기술 거버넌스, 리스크 관리 및 기술 지원 조직을 이끌게 됩니다. 단순 시설관리 역할이 아닌, Mechanical & Electrical(M&E) 전문성을 기반으로 현장 운영 최적화, 기술 자문, 감사 대응, 교육 체계 구축 및 사업 성장을 주도하는 포지션입니다. 글로벌 및 APAC 조직과 긴밀히 협업하며, 한국 내 엔지니어링 조직의 역량 향상과 운영 혁신을 이끌 수 있는 경험 많은 리더를 찾고 있습니다. 주요 업무 한국 내 엔지니어링 운영 표준 및 Compliance 관리 Engineering Audit 수행 및 개선 과제 리딩 Incident Investigation 및 Risk Management 지원 주요 사업장 Technical Review 및 법규 준수 점검 Engineering Community 운영 및 Best Practice 공유 엔지니어링 교육 프로그램 기획 및 운영 현장 엔지니어 대상 기술 자문 및 문제 해결 지원 신규 사업 수주(RFI/RFP) 및 기술 솔루션 지원 설비 실사(Due Diligence) 및 유지보수 전략 검토 Mobile Technical Service 조직 관리 및 성장 전략 수립 사업 운영 성과 및 P&L 관리 APAC 및 글로벌 프로젝트 참여 및 협업 자격 요건 기계공학, 전기공학 또는 관련 공학 전공 학사 이상 Facility Engineering, Technical Services 또는 Engineering Operations 경력 10년 이상 M&E(Mechanical & Electrical) 설비 운영 및 유지보수 경험 복수 사업장 또는 대규모 시설 운영 경험 Engineering Audit, Compliance 또는 Risk Management 경험 엔지니어링 조직 관리 및 리더십 경험 우수한 문제 해결 능력 및 커뮤니케이션 역량 Microsoft Office 활용 능력 (Excel, PowerPoint 등) 글로벌 조직과 원활한 협업이 가능한 영어 역량 우대 사항 글로벌 FM(Facility Management) 기업 근무 경험 데이터센터, 반도체, 첨단 제조시설 운영 경험 Technical Services 조직 운영 경험 P&L 또는 사업 운영 관리 경험 Engineering Training 체계 구축 경험 Lean Six Sigma Green Belt 이상 보유자 APAC 또는 글로벌 프로젝트 수행 경험 👉 단순한 시설 운영 포지션이 아닙니다. 한국 Engineering Operations의 전략, 기술 표준, 조직 역량을 총괄하는 리더급 포지션입니다. Facility Management, Data Center, Semiconductor, Manufacturing Environment 등에서 엔지니어링 조직을 이끌어 본 분들에게 매우 매력적인 기회가 될 것입니다. 관심 있으신 분은 LinkedIn 메시지 또는 별도 연락 주시면 상세 내용을 안내드리겠습니다.

review_candidates.description: Descripción del puesto Como Ejecutivo corporativo en AC-MOBILETECH S.A.S., te encargarás de gestionar y desarrollar relaciones con clientes corporativos, identificando oportunidades de negocio y asegurando un servicio de alta calidad. En tu día a día realizarás visitas y reuniones con clientes, prepararás propuestas comerciales, negociarás condiciones y harás seguimiento a contratos y proyectos en curso. También coordinarás internamente con las áreas técnicas y de soporte para garantizar la correcta implementación de las soluciones ofrecidas. Este es un puesto a tiempo completo, presencial, ubicado en Quito. Requisitos: Contar con aptitudes comerciales sólidas: negociación, identificación de oportunidades, cierre de ventas y orientación a resultados. Poseer aptitudes de comunicación y relación interpersonal: escucha activa, trato cercano con clientes corporativos y capacidad para presentar propuestas de forma clara y persuasiva. Tener organización y gestión del tiempo: planificación de agenda, seguimiento de cuentas clave y manejo simultáneo de varios proyectos. Formación recomendada en áreas como administración de empresas, comercial, marketing, comunicaciones o similares. Valorable experiencia previa en puestos corporativos B2B, preferiblemente en sectores de tecnología, telecomunicaciones o servicios empresariales. Capacidad para trabajar en equipo, adaptarte a cambios y usar herramientas digitales de gestión de clientes (CRM), ofimática y comunicación online. Ofrecemos: Salario Fijo $532 + Comisiones Plan Carrera Bonos e incentivos

review_candidates.title: Director International Programs & Commercialization
review_candidates.description: Job Title: Director International Programs & Commercialization Location: Torrance, CA (in-office) Reports To: Head of Program Management Operations (PMO) Position Overview The Director of International Programs & Commercialization will establish and implement scalable internal processes and best practices that ensure compliant and efficient global program operations and commercial sales delivery workflows. This role partners closely with Epirus Business Development (BD), Growth, and Execution teams on proposals, supports customer acquisition, and leads system delivery planning, training, and operational fielding of Critical Point Defense-High Power Microwave systems to allied countries. They will have full ownership for the successful execution and delivery of Epirus systems and services to customers. The ideal candidate has deep experience in commercial products, program management, and international partners and government engagement. Key Responsibilities Lead cross functional team across the full lifecycle of international & commercial sales programs, including scope and contract requirements flow down, planning, budgeting, execution and sustainment. Responsible for forecasting, monitoring and achieving financial milestones and schedule performance objectives. Serve as the primary interface between customers and internal execution teams, acting as the voice-of-customer (VOC). Develop and implement scalable, standardized programmatic best practices, risk management and associated workflows for international contracts. Partner with business development and growth teams on capture opportunities and partnerships, non-DoD. Monitor geopolitical conditions, and regulatory constraints that influence program success and recommend risk mitigation strategies. Ensure all international activities adhere to ITAR/EAR restrictions, provisos and customer terms and conditions. Work with Growth and Sales teams regarding direct to market sales of commercial products, ensuring full execution success from order, through manufacturing and delivery. Coordinate demonstration events, field trials, technology evaluations and showcase engagements for both international and domestic customers. Oversee planning, logistics, and resourcing for annual demonstration events. Prepare concise program reporting, performance dashboards, and executive‑level briefings. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Mgt, or related fields. 8–12+ years of experience managing complex international programs in advanced‑technology sectors. Demonstrated success leading customer facing programs involving multinational partner networks. Hands‑on experience coordinating field demonstrations, test events, or technology showcase activities in international or operational settings. Strong understanding of defense procurement pathways, direct commercial sales, export controls (ITAR/EAR), and compliance requirements. Exceptional communication, negotiation, and relationship‑building skills across culturally diverse and highly technical environments. Ability to manage budgets, timelines, and deliverables for complex technical programs. Ability to travel internationally and domestically, as required. Preferred Skills And Experience Strategic thought leadership in global defense markets Program and Risk management best practices International and government customer communication Operational planning and demonstration Executive reporting and stakeholder engagement As required by the Equal Pay Transparency Act, Epirus provides a reasonable range of minimum compensation for roles that may be hired. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and specific office location. For the state of California only, the range of starting pay for this role is: $208,000—$241,000 USD
